Hi Kaya — thanks for the clear list. Happy to align. High level answers and a couple of options below. I've attached our invoice slot options spreadsheet for your AP team to look at.

Short answers:
- PO format: We can accept your PO-YYYY-XXXXX pattern. Key requirement is that PO number lands in the PO field on the invoice (ERP matching).
- Invoice cadence: We support both per-event invoices and consolidated weekly statements. For weekly statements we prefer a Friday cut (invoices generated Saturdays, sent to your AP mailbox).
- Net terms: Standard is net30 for new customers. We can consider net45 for approved procurement with an offset on discount bands.

Options that impact discount eligibility:
1) Weekly consolidated statement (Friday cut) + net30 = eligible for standard volume discount (5% on committed tier).
2) Weekly + net45 = discount reduced by 1–2 percentage points unless prepay/commitment applied.
3) Per-event invoicing with monthly reconciliation = eligible for same discounts as option 1.

Action items:
- Can you confirm whether Novapulse will use weekly statements or per-event invoices?
- Please attach your final PO file (we received your template but want the completed PO number and remit info).

Attached: Redwood_Invoice_Slot_Options.xlsx (spreadsheet with sample cutoffs and file examples)

Thanks — we can loop in finance to confirm the final discounts once we see the PO cadence.

Best,
